text: Beeswax here. Shop steward, Local Twenty Thousand. I'm in your ear now. Congratulations, scout.
Six things in here matter to bees. Point your face at them. When I ask, say yes.
Bee fact found!

label: beehive
text: That's a hive. Union headquarters. Want the gossip?

label: beehive
text: The queen lays the eggs. The girls do the work. Drones like me get kicked out every fall. The nerve.

label: native_flower
text: A native flower. That's the cafeteria. Want the menu?

label: native_flower
text: Plant native flowers that bloom spring to fall. Keeps the cafeteria open. Even a balcony pot counts.

label: honey_jar
text: Honey. From a STORE. Delicious for you, suspicious for us. Should I tell you why?

label: honey_jar
text: Never feed it to bees. It can carry foulbrood. Its spores last decades. Fine on toast, deadly in a hive.

label: pebble_dish
text: A water dish with pebbles! Somebody gets it. Want to know the trick?

label: pebble_dish
text: We can't swim, so pebbles are our landing pad. The girls haul water home and fan it. Bee air conditioning.

label: bug_spray
text: Bug spray. I'm filing a grievance. Can I read it to you?

label: bug_spray
text: Spray drifts onto flowers. The girls carry it home to the babies. Demand: skip it near anything blooming.

label: bee_hotel
text: Housing for my wild cousins. No rent, no beekeeper. Ready for the tour?

label: bee_hotel
text: Seven in ten wild bees nest underground. Leave bare dirt and old stems, and my cousins move right in.
Fine. Tabled for later.
Your loss. I'll tell the next scout.
Rude. I'm right here in your ear. That's going in the minutes.
Nothing? I'll put you down as a no.
Slow shift. Walk up to something and stare at it. I'll do the rest.
One down. Five to go.
Two. The union's mildly impressed.
Three down. Halfway. I'd help, but drones don't scout. It's in the contract.
Four. You're making me look good.
Five. One left. Don't you dare slow down.
Six for six. New contract: plant native flowers, skip the bug spray, put out a pebble dish. Motion carried.
